## Featured Systems Work

<div class="featured-project-grid">
  <a class="featured-project-card" href="https://github.com/AmanPandey28/GPU-Mode/tree/main" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
    <span class="featured-project-kicker">Agentic CUDA Engineering</span>
    <span class="featured-project-title">GPU Mode B200 QR Decomposition</span>
    <span class="featured-project-description">
      Multi-agent CUDA workflow for batched FP32 QR on B200, with permission gates,
      worktree handoffs, smoke tests, and reproducible Modal/Popcorn runs.
    </span>
    <span class="featured-project-footer">23.7% geomean reduction · Householder QR · B200</span>
  </a>

  <a class="featured-project-card" href="https://github.com/AmanPandey28/cross_dsl_kernels" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
    <span class="featured-project-kicker">Cross-DSL Kernels</span>
    <span class="featured-project-title">LLM Inference Kernel Engineering</span>
    <span class="featured-project-description">
      FP32 RMSNorm, decode GEMV/GEMM, and RoPE-KV kernels implemented across
      CUDA C++, Triton, and CuTe DSL with shared tests and CUDA-event benchmarks.
    </span>
    <span class="featured-project-footer">CUDA C++ · Triton · CuTe DSL · cuBLASLt</span>
  </a>

  <a class="featured-project-card" href="https://github.com/AmanPandey28/nano_vllm_pp" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
    <span class="featured-project-kicker">Inference Runtime</span>
    <span class="featured-project-title">nano-vLLM++</span>
    <span class="featured-project-description">
      Single-GPU LLM runtime with request state machines, prefill/decode separation,
      KV-cache metadata, quantized loading paths, and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
    </span>
    <span class="featured-project-footer">KV cache · NF4/INT8 · TTFT/TPOT metrics</span>
  </a>

  <a class="featured-project-card" href="https://github.com/AmanPandey28/triton-flash-attention" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
    <span class="featured-project-kicker">Attention Kernels</span>
    <span class="featured-project-title">FlashAttention-2 in Triton</span>
    <span class="featured-project-description">
      Fused Triton FA2 forward/backward implementation with online softmax,
      recomputed backward attention weights, causal masking, and autotuned kernels.
    </span>
    <span class="featured-project-footer">4K context · 16.2 TFLOP/s · Forward/backward</span>
  </a>
</div>
